Hello,

We have sent you a few mails on "Managed Optical Bypass Switch" and you never had a reason to answer — fair enough. No brochure this time, just one question:

For the site cabinets behind your remotely monitored cameras, a DIN-rail 4-port gigabit PoE switch rated −40 to +75 °C is $35.5 EXW and the managed 8-port version $137.5; do your towers run 48 V or 24 V DC inside?

Prices are USD EXW, 2026-10-17 snapshot, valid 15 days.

If it is not relevant now, a one-word reply is enough and I will take you off the catalog mails.

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
